extraction.name: CONTEXTUAL
extraction.description: CONTEXTUAL is a context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning dataset consisting of 506 human-crafted instructions for evaluating large multimodal models across eight real-world scenarios.
extraction.creator: Rohan Wadhawan (University of California Los Angeles); Hritik Bansal (University of California Los Angeles); Kai-Wei Chang (University of California Los Angeles); Nanyun Peng (University of California Los Angeles)
extraction.citeAs: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng. Evaluating Context-Sensitive Text-Rich Visual Reasoning in Large Multimodal Models. Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were sourced from existing datasets (LAION-5B, Rico, InfographicVQA, STVQA, ESTVQA) using keyword searches and heuristic-based OCR filtering, and by scraping website links from the Open WebText Initiative to collect screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images from the LAION-5B, Rico, InfographicVQA, STVQA, and ESTVQA datasets, along with website links from the Open WebText Initiative.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Authors were divided into two groups to annotate specific categories following guidelines. MTurk workers verified the correctness of each <image, instruction, response> sample, and author groups reviewed samples created by the other group. For human evaluation, annotators rated predicted response quality.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: MTurk workers verified the correctness of each sample, and author groups reviewed samples created by the other group to filter out low-quality samples. For human evaluation of model responses, a majority vote among three annotators was used as the final decision.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Human annotators, mainly from the US, to provide responses to establish a human baseline. We are aware that the linguistic diversity and writing style of the human responses would change with different social groups.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Human annotators were mainly from the US, meaning the linguistic diversity and writing style of the human responses would change with different social groups.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: We are aware that the existing multimodal models are capable of generating harmful responses, despite the presence of safeguard filter.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: We did not observe any apparent harmful and privacy sensitive information in them.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluate the context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning capabilities of large multimodal models.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset and code are made available along with a continuously updated leaderboard with recent LMMs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images underwent manual filtering or heuristic-based filtering using PaddleOCR to select the top 500 images with the highest number of words. Incorrect and low-quality samples were also filtered out after human verification.
